cards.text: John is writing down a vision to send to the seven churches in the province of Asia (Revelation 1:4, 11). He just heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, shouting that the marriage of the Lamb has come and the bride was given fine linen, bright and pure (Revelation 19:6-8). Now John sees heaven standing open, and there before him is a white horse with a rider.
That rider is called Faithful and True. John says He does two things: He judges, and He wages war.

cards.question: The rider called Faithful and True judges and wages war with ___.

cards.text: His eyes are like blazing fire, and He has many royal crowns on His head. He also has a name written on Him, and John never tells us what it says.

cards.question: Only the rider Himself knows the name written on Him.

cards.text: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God. Then come the armies of heaven, on white horses.

cards.question: The armies of heaven ride out ahead of the rider on the white horse.
The armies of heaven follow the rider on white horses. What are they dressed in?

cards.text: My apron starts out white too, friend, and it stays that way for about FOUR SECONDS into a batch. Then a sharp sword proceeds from the rider's mouth.

cards.question: A sharp sword proceeds from the rider's mouth, and it's for striking down the ___.

cards.text: He will rule the nations with an iron scepter. And John says He treads a winepress.

cards.question: The rider treads the winepress of the fury of someone's wrath. Whose wrath is it?

cards.text: One more name, and this one is written right on His robe and on His thigh.

cards.question: The rider wears many royal crowns. What name is written on His robe and on His thigh?

answers.text: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS
HOLY HOLY HOLY LORD GOD ALMIGHTY
MIGHTY GOD AND PRINCE OF PEACE

cards.text: Then John sees an angel standing in the sun, crying out in a loud voice. Standing in the SUN, friend, and I break a sweat just opening my oven door.

cards.question: The angel standing in the sun cries out in a loud voice. Who is he calling to?

cards.text: He tells the birds, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God…" They're called to eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders.

cards.question: The angel's list of whose flesh the birds will eat covers only the powerful.

cards.text: The list takes in everyone, slave and free, small and great. Then John sees the beast, the one he saw rising out of the sea (Revelation 13:1), and the kings of the earth with their armies, assembled for war.

cards.question: The beast and the kings of the earth assemble their armies to wage war. Who are they going up against?
The beast goes up against the rider and ends up captured.
The false prophet, who acted on the beast's behalf, is captured along with it. What had he done?

answers.text: Written new laws for the kings

cards.text: Both the beast and the false prophet are thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur. The rest are killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse.
And all the birds the angel called gorge themselves on their flesh.
